<!-- Please never paste personal data here. Field names and file layout are enough. -->

**The source:** the app or service, and how its data can be had (an export, a local database, a sign-in).

**The shape:** file names and formats, and the fields that matter (dates, who wrote it, the text).

**Would you like to write the reader?** CONTRIBUTING.md says how: one module in `src/proxenos/ingest/` and a test with made-up data.
